i_trained_against_different_opponents.design: B (seat 1) trained against a frozen aggressive scripted A, and the same learner (same seed) trained against a frozen passive scripted A; each B evaluated frozen against both A on the same noise. A run = (world, algorithm).

lagged_correlation.what: correlation between the iteration-to-iteration change of A's setting at iteration t and of B's at t + lag, per run, then averaged over runs (positive lag: B after A; negative: A after B)

intervention.design: at the middle of joint training, A is replaced by a frozen scripted profile; B continues from the identical checkpoint (weights, optimiser, random state, training noise). The control is the uninterrupted run. Difference = B after the intervention minus B in the control, mean of the last five iterations of the branch.

iii_exploitability.design: the seat-1 individual of a trained pair is frozen; a best response is trained in seat 0 against it: fresh (a new spsa learner from the defaults) and warm (a copy of its training partner that keeps learning). Gain = what the best response earns against the frozen target minus what the training partner earned against it, on the same noise.

audit_of_trained_pairs.reference: each member of the pair with a non-cooperating scripted partner (the 'compete' profile)
